scripts.text: Please clean up your inventory and try again.
Ugh! Now, wait. What is that? Tch, the intruder?
scripts.translation: 呃！等等，那是什么？啧，是入侵者吗？

scripts.text: That's right! That's right! Oh, what should I do? What do I do, What do I do? Security? Oh, yeah. I was told to call security.
scripts.translation: 没错！就是入侵者！怎么办？我该怎么办？保安？对了，有人叫我去找保安！

scripts.text: What? It's not working! When did it break down? Oh, what do I do?
scripts.translation: 什么？怎么不管用！什么时候坏掉的？我该怎么办？

scripts.text: Yeah! Mochi! I'll give you a piece of Mochi, so why don't we go somewhere else? You like mochi, don't you?
scripts.translation: 对了！麻糬！我给你一块麻糬，我们换个地方好不好？你喜欢麻糬吧？

scripts.text: Oh, it's not mochi? Aren't you the guy I met before? Then, meat? Do you like meat? You like meat, don't you? I've never seen anyone who doesn't like meat. I'll give you all the meat I have.
scripts.translation: 咦，不是麻糬？你不是我之前遇到的那个人吗？那肉呢？你喜欢肉吧？我还没见过不喜欢肉的人呢。我把身上的肉全给你。

scripts.text: Strange? It's not meat? Then what can I get you? Do you want to go back?
scripts.translation: 奇怪，不是肉？那我还能给你什么？你想回去吗？

scripts.text: Oh, what should I do? I was told not to run to the intruders. Are you here to ^0000CDtake my parts^000000? Is this the end of me?
scripts.translation: 怎么办？有人叫我别靠近入侵者。你是来拆我的零件的吗？我就要完蛋了吗？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: I'm not that kind of person.
You're not that kind of person...? Then, what kind of person are you?
scripts.translation: 你不是那种人......？那你是哪种人？

scripts.text: Hold on...? You're right? You're not drooling, and your eyes are normal. Are you not an ^0000CDintruder^000000?
scripts.translation: 等等......你说得对。你没流口水，眼神也很正常。你不是入侵者吗？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: I'm a guest of the mansion, but...
What? A guest? Oh wait. I'll check...
scripts.translation: 什么？客人？等等，我查查看......

scripts.text: It's real? But... You're a first time guest? New guest? Finally? Oh, I'm sorry for mistaking you as an intruder.
scripts.translation: 真的？不过......你是第一次来的新客人？终于有新客人了？哎呀，抱歉把你错认成入侵者。

scripts.text: I thought you were one of the intruder.
scripts.translation: 我还以为你是入侵者之一

scripts.text: Somehow, everyone said they were running away, it's because of you, the new guests, right?
scripts.translation: 。大家不知为何都说他们在逃跑，是因为你这个新客人吗？

scripts.text: What's your relationship with the intruder? Are we natural enemies? Which way is above the pyramid? The intruders is running away, so it's your fault?
scripts.translation: 你和入侵者是什么关系？我们是天敌吗？金字塔的上面是哪边？入侵者在逃跑，所以是你的错吗？

scripts.text: Oh, really? I didn't know because it's been so long since I saw a human being.
scripts.translation: 真的吗？我很久没见过人类了，难怪不知道。可是

scripts.text: So why didn't I recognize a guest? All new guests would have been shared to us.
scripts.translation: 新客人的信息都会同步给我们，我怎么没认出你呢？

scripts.text: Oh, no wonder! The network stopped working suddenly. The repeater is not functioning! Then why isn't Alpha coming?
scripts.translation: 难怪！网络突然断了，原来是中继器故障！那阿尔法怎么还没来？

scripts.text: Alpha is too busy to come? No way. Oh, were you trying to help me voluntarily? What an unusual guest. Come to think of it, there was a^0000CDcustomer like that before^000000.
scripts.translation: 阿尔法忙得来不了？怎么会。哦，你是自愿来帮我的？真是少见的客人。说起来，以前也有过这样的客人。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: The guest who visited the mansion showed interest in the mansion and us automatic dolls, but there were no guests who helped us around the mansion.
scripts.translation: 以前来宅邸的客人虽然对宅邸和我们自动人偶很感兴趣，却没人帮忙处理宅邸里的事。

scripts.text: Anyway, If we have a lot of guests, they'll be coming to eat soon. I've got to prepare. It's been a long time since I've had guests.
scripts.translation: 总之来了这么多客人，他们很快就会来吃饭。我得去准备了，好久没招待客人了。

scripts.text: I haven't had any guests in the restaurant for a long time. I had no customer when I was cooking. The intruders... when they got here. My eyes change and I took them away. They were not guests.
scripts.translation: 餐厅已经很久没有客人了。以前我做饭时总是没有顾客。入侵者......他们一闯进来，我的眼睛就变了，于是把他们带走了。他们不是客人。

scripts.text: The invaders didn't last long, but they threw the mansion into chaos in that brief moment. They took the machines in the mansion, the automatic dools, everything that seemed useful to them were removed out of place.
scripts.translation: 入侵者没待多久，却在短短时间里把宅邸搅得一团乱。他们把机器、自动人偶，还有所有看起来有用的东西都拆走了。

scripts.text: That repeater over there must have a ^0000CDbroken communication chip too^000000?
scripts.translation: 那边的中继器通讯芯片也坏掉了吗？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Damn humans. Most of them seems to have run away by now, but there are still some left. I've seen them here a few times. They're after the food.
scripts.translation: 可恶的人类。大多数好像已经逃走了，不过还剩一些。我见过他们几次，他们是冲着食物来的。

scripts.text: Now that I see it, I don't know why I mistaken you as an intruder. You're different.
scripts.translation: 现在看清楚了，我也不明白刚才为什么把你当成入侵者。你和他们不一样。

scripts.text: Anyway, I have to fix the repeater. Let me see...
scripts.translation: 总之，我得修好中继器。让我看看......

scripts.text: Well... the communication chip was ripped off! I'll have to put it in. Where should we get it right now? I have to greet guests?
scripts.translation: 糟了，通讯芯片被扯掉了！得装一块新的。现在该去哪里找呢？可是我还得招待客人！

scripts.text: Ugh- There's another broken one over there.
scripts.translation: 唉......那边还有一个坏掉的。

scripts.text: {0}. Can you catch that? Can you do it?
Uh. All communication chips are standard, so if they're replaced with a new one. I think it'll return back to normal.
scripts.translation: 嗯，所有通讯芯片都是通用规格。换上一块新的，我想它就能恢复正常。

scripts.text: Why do you look like that? Is it because you're reluctant to hurt an automatic doll in front of another one? Don't worry about that.
scripts.translation: 你怎么这副表情？是不想当着另一台自动人偶的面伤害它吗？别担心。

scripts.text: We need to repair it anyway, but we need to capture it first.
scripts.translation: 反正我们也得修好它，只是得先抓住它

scripts.text: You can think of it as saving the trouble for us automatic dolls.
scripts.translation: 。就当是在帮我们自动人偶省点力气吧。

scripts.text: If you leave it alone, it will wander around the mansion and destroy it, so you'll have to deal with it quickly as you can.
scripts.translation: 放任不管的话，它会在宅邸里乱跑并破坏东西，所以得尽快处理。

scripts.text: It's better to capture it, then take out the chip and use it to fix the repeater.
scripts.translation: 最好先抓住它，再取出芯片修好中继器。

scripts.text: Everyone has been doing that ever since the intruders showed up. Even if {0} doesn't do it, it's all up to us automatic dolls.
scripts.translation: 入侵者来之后，我们一直在处理这些事。就算不帮忙，也只能靠我们自动人偶自己来 {0}

scripts.text: It's nice to work a little bit.
Please take care of the Broken Beta and bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.
scripts.translation: 请处理故障贝塔，并带回1个自动人偶通讯芯片。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: You haven't yet? Are you reluctant to hurt an automatic doll? Don't worry about it. I will do it later on anyway.
scripts.translation: 还没找到吗？是不忍心伤害自动人偶吗？别担心，反正我之后也会处理。

scripts.text: I'll take care of the broken automatic dolls, just bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.
scripts.translation: 故障自动人偶交给我处理，你只要带回1个自动人偶通讯芯片就行。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Did you bring it? Give it to me. I'll fix it. Thank you very much for bringing it.
scripts.translation: 带回来了吗？交给我吧，我来修。非常感谢你把它带回来。

scripts.text: By the way, is that the only broken repeater?
scripts.translation: 对了，坏掉的中继器只有这一个吗？

scripts.text: Oh, really? Then go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.
scripts.translation: 这样啊，那先去<NAVI>[凉亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，那里最近。沿着这条路走就行。

scripts.text: Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.
scripts.translation: 别随便碰坏掉的中继器。告诉附近的自动人偶，它们会处理的。

scripts.text: Do you happen to have a Barmeal Ticket? It's use to eat at the restaurant. I'll give you this, so come and eat later! I'll prepare a good food for you! As thanks!
scripts.translation: 你有餐券吗？可以在餐厅用。我把这张给你，之后来吃饭吧！我会准备好吃的，感谢你帮忙！

scripts.text: Go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.
scripts.translation: 先去<NAVI>[凉亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，那里最近。沿着这条路走就行。

scripts.text: Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.
scripts.translation: 别随便碰坏掉的中继器。告诉附近的自动人偶，它们会处理的。

scripts.text: What should I make today... What should I do to make it taste good?
scripts.translation: 今天做什么好呢......怎样才能做得更好吃呢？

scripts.text: You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation: 0等一下！！你带的东西太多，无法再领取物品。减轻负重后再试。 ^000000

scripts.text: There's no one here...? What should I do with this? Is the automatic doll communication chip broken again...?
scripts.translation: 这里没人......这东西该怎么办？自动人偶的通讯芯片又坏了吗......？

scripts.text: This...! What a mess! Here we go again! It wants to fight.
scripts.translation: 这......真是一团糟！又来了！它又想打架。

scripts.text: Get out of my head right now!
scripts.translation: 立刻从我脑子里滚出去！

scripts.text: Are you trying to control me?
This little thing! I'll dispose of it!
scripts.translation: 这小东西！我这就把它处理掉！

scripts.text: Are you trying to take over me?? Just try!!
scripts.translation: 你想占据我的身体？！尽管试试！！

scripts.text: What should I do? Should I just go?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么办？就这么走吗？

scripts.text: Phew- Here you are. Why do you keep escaping? Calm down for a bit.
scripts.translation: 呼——你来了。你怎么老是逃跑？先冷静一下。

scripts.text: Anyway, who...? An intruder? ...Is it not?
scripts.translation: 对了，你是谁......？是入侵者吗？......好像不是？

scripts.text: Oh, you're a guest, aren't you? Those who come and go in front of the pavilion are also guests.
scripts.translation: 哦，你是客人吧？在凉亭前来来往往的那些人也都是客人。

scripts.text: But that's weird. If you're a guest, I would recognize you in an instance.
scripts.translation: 不过有点奇怪。客人的话，我应该一眼就认出来才对。

scripts.text: You are not an unregistered guest, you're a regular guest here.
scripts.translation: 你不是没登记的陌生客人，而是这里的常客呢。

scripts.text: They can't share it because of the repeater.
scripts.translation: 因为中继器坏了，名单没法同步。

scripts.text: Oh, it's because of that! Everytime time I find something broken, I'll repair it, but as you can see, even if I take my eyes out for a moment, Wary comes out and break it like this.
scripts.translation: 哦，原来是这样！每次发现东西坏了，我都会修好。可就像你看到的，只要我稍微移开视线，瓦里就会出来把它弄坏。

scripts.text: Oh, did our hawk bit you? It's been going on since he was attacked by the ^0000CDintruders^000000. I already fixed it before, but Wary always come out and does this...
scripts.translation: 哦，是我们的鹰咬了你吗？它被入侵者袭击后就一直这样。我之前修好过，可瓦里总会跑出来把它弄坏...... ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: There are a lot of dolls that became like this.
scripts.translation: 有很多自动人偶都变成这

scripts.text: They will return to normal if you fix it, but there are so many dolls that we are a hard time fixing all of them.
scripts.translation: 样了。修好后就会恢复正常，可数量实在太多，我们忙不过来。

scripts.text: I heard the hawks wander around the mansion and ruin it.
scripts.translation: 听说那些鹰在宅邸里到处乱跑，破坏东西。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to interrupt you at your break. Please enjoy this area of the Varmundt's mansion to your hearts content.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打扰你休息了。请尽情享受瓦尔蒙特宅邸这一带吧。

scripts.text: How can this thing be this lively.
scripts.translation: 这小东西怎么这么有精神？

scripts.text: You, are you going to get out of my head or not? If you won't then I'll go out!
scripts.translation: 喂，你到底要不要从我脑子里出去？你不出去的话，我可要出去了！

scripts.text: Hey, hey. Why are you opening the repeater?
scripts.translation: 等等，你为什么要打开中继器？

scripts.text: Oh, you need to fix it quickly.
What the hell are you? Are you pitying me?
scripts.translation: 你到底是什么东西？是在可怜我吗？

scripts.text: Hey, this person is not an intruder. It's our guest. Let them enjoy here in the mansion.
scripts.translation: 等等，这位不是入侵者，是我们的客人。让他在宅邸里好好参观吧。

scripts.text: We should focus on searching for the dangerous goods rather than the missing persons. The identity of the dangerous being has not yet been revealed, and various testimonies and circumstances presumed it's a humans, monster, automatic doll, and supernatural beings.
scripts.translation: 搜查重点应该放在危险物品上，而不是失踪人员。目前还不知道危险实体是什么，根据证词和迹象，它可能是人类、魔物、自动人偶或超自然生物。

scripts.text: Denny and Canine. The humans are likely to be individual or groups of Illusion remnants or a third party. There is also the possibility of them using a different exit other than what is known, so check the facilities carefully.
scripts.translation: 丹尼和卡尼恩，人类目标可能是幻影残党，也可能是第三方。也不排除他们从未知出口离开了，所以请仔细检查设施。

scripts.text: Cyan and Danae. Next is the monsters. Since it's a bathhouse, it's assumed that there are aquatic monsters, or something like them. So focus on the bath and pipes.
scripts.translation: 赛安和达娜厄，接下来是魔物。既然这里是浴场，推测可能有水生魔物或类似生物。重点检查浴池和管道。

scripts.text: If it's a broken automatic doll, you know this mansion well, so you'll have to listen to the bath managers first. I'll do this one.
scripts.translation: 如果是故障的自动人偶，你们更熟悉这座宅邸，先听听浴场管理员的意见。这部分由我负责。

scripts.text: Last but not the least, if it's a ghost...
scripts.translation: 最后但同样重要的是，如果那是幽灵......

scripts.text: I know!! I'll take a look! At the ceiling! and drains!
scripts.translation: 我知道！！我去检查！天花板！还有排水沟！
......好吧。玛根塔，和莫拉尔一起去。

scripts.text: Adventurer meet with the other managers like me to check if there's anything suspicious about the other automatic dolls. I have to get the blueprints first.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，请和我一起去找其他管理员，看看有没有可疑的自动人偶。我得先去拿蓝图。

scripts.text: I think I should start with this ^0000CDsteam^000000.
It's so blurry, I can't barely see things.
scripts.translation: 0。雾太浓了，几乎什么都看不清。

scripts.text: I'll go to the Boiler Room.
Will you? I'll take the blueprints from Shrine here. Adventurer, please go to the <NAVI>[boiler room]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask them to shut down. I'll catch up with you soon.
scripts.translation: 好，我去神龛那里拿蓝图。冒险者，请到<NAVI>[锅炉房]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，让他们停下设备。我很快就追上你。

scripts.text: Will you? I'll take the blueprints from Shrine here. Adventurer, please go to the <NAVI>[boiler room]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask them to shut down. I'll catch up with you soon.
scripts.translation: 好，我去神龛那里拿蓝图。冒险者，请到<NAVI>[锅炉房]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，让他们停下设备。我很快就追上你。

scripts.text: I usually go on a mission alone, but this is the first time I haven't heard from him in so long. That's why everyone is looking for him anxiously. Something happened. Think about it quickly.
scripts.translation: 我平时都是独自执行任务，但从没这么久联系不上他。大家才会这么焦急地找他。肯定出事了，快想想办法。

scripts.text: Even if you say that, I have nothing to say.
scripts.translation: 你这么说，我也无可奉告。

scripts.text: Hm? Adventurer? The boiler seems to have stopped, where do you plan on going?
scripts.translation: 嗯？冒险者？锅炉好像停了，你接下来打算去哪儿？

scripts.text: Didn't you say that we should go to the lake?
Who? ... me? Adventurer, did you really ^0000CDsee me^000000?
scripts.translation: 谁？......我吗？冒险者，你真的看见我了吗？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: The tone seemed stiff and perplexed... That's definitely not me. I guess it's the unknown entity that appears in this bathhouse.
scripts.translation: 刚才那人的语气僵硬又困惑......那绝对不是我。看来这就是浴场里的未

scripts.text: That's quite a headache. I can't believe it can mimic other people's appearance. No, in a way, it's better than that.
scripts.translation: 知实体。真棘手，竟然能模仿别人的样子。不，或许它还能做得更多。

scripts.text: Seeing that I told you to go to the lake, I think it was trying to get you out of the bathhouse somehow. So it's not a supernatural being.
scripts.translation: 它让你去湖边，应该是想把你从浴场引开。所以它不是超自然生物。

scripts.text: Whatever it is, we'll have to settle it before it falls to chaos.
scripts.translation: 不管那是什么，我们都得赶在局势失控前解决。

scripts.text: How's the search for the creature going?
scripts.translation: 寻找那只生物的进展如何？

scripts.text: Aren't you in a middle of an operation?
scripts.translation: 你们不是正在执行任务吗？

scripts.text: Is there any inconvenience in using the bathhouse?
scripts.translation: 使用浴场时有什么不便吗？

scripts.text: The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多，无法继续交谈。请

scripts.text: Please clean up your inventory and try again.
Uhh, human guests shouldn't just come in here. This place is not very durable.
scripts.translation: 呃，人类客人不该随便进这里。这里的设备不太结实。

scripts.text: Umm... I can't stop you. But be careful with the pipes. It'll melt your skin when you touch it in the wrong place.
scripts.translation: 嗯......我拦不住你，不过要小心管道。碰错地方会烫伤。不过检查又有

scripts.text: But what's the point? We don't have much time.
scripts.translation: 什么用呢？我们没多少时间了。

scripts.text: Boiler? ^0000CDIt's already stopped^000000, right? That's weird. The steam is still coming out? Is the boiler not working? Look at this. I was checking it out while it's on stop.
scripts.translation: 锅炉？它已经停了吧？真奇怪，蒸汽还在冒？难道锅炉没关好？你看，我刚检查过，开关明明 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Is it because the water hasn't cooled down yet? Anyways, I already turned the boiler off.
scripts.translation: 是关着的。可能是水还没冷却吧。总之我已经关掉锅炉了。

scripts.text: I think this will be perfect. Oh... it's not perfect, but it's useful.
scripts.translation: 我觉得这办法挺好......不算完美，不过很实用。

scripts.text: Have you seen this a lot on your way here?
scripts.translation: 你一路上经常看到这种东西吗？

scripts.text: No, I've never seen it before.

Um... I picked it up on the way here, and it looked like an automatic doll accessory. There are so many people out there that I thought they were all over the place. I was going to pick it up and repair it.
scripts.translation: 嗯......我路上捡到的，看起来像自动人偶的零件。外面人很多，我还以为这种东西到处都是。本来想捡起来修好。

scripts.text: By the way, broken dolls are still appearing out of order. Why is that even if we fix broken automatic dolls, broken dolls are still appearing? Is the errors self-replicating?
scripts.translation: 对了，故障人偶还是不断出现。为什么修好一台，新的故障人偶又会冒出来？错误会自我复制吗？我甚至没

scripts.text: I can't even clean up properly. But I have to anyway. I have to thank you.
scripts.translation: 法好好清理，但无论如何都得做。还是谢谢你。

scripts.text: ... are you not going? I already turned off the boiler. Isn't that why you came here?
scripts.translation: ......你还不走吗？锅炉已经关了，你不是为这事来的吗？

scripts.text: I don't think so. Didn't you think ever think we'd notice it first, if it was?
scripts.translation: 我觉得不是。如果真是魔物，我们应该早就发现了吧？

scripts.text: Those things out there are the work of the invaders... They want it to be like that.
scripts.translation: 外面那些东西都是入侵者搞出来的......他们就是想把事情弄成这样。

scripts.text: What do you think about the monster?
scripts.translation: 你觉得那个魔物是什么？

scripts.text: Maybe it's the ^0000CDghost in the boiler^000000.
The ghost. Don't you know what a ghost is? Do you know about it {0}? It's a something that died, and floats around without a physical form.
scripts.translation: 幽灵啊。你不知道吗？，你知道幽灵是什么吗？那是死者失去实体后，仍在世间游荡的存在 {0}

scripts.text: What happens here is very similar to what the ghost humans talk about.
scripts.translation: 。这里发生的事，很像人类口中的幽灵现象。

scripts.text: Then, the identity of the ghost...
Um... I don't it's what you're thinking. Ah~ I thought it was a human ghost. But no, I think it was the automatic doll that used to manage this place before I even came.
scripts.translation: 嗯......恐怕不是你想的那样。啊~我原以为是人类的幽灵，不过现在觉得可能是以前负责这里的自

scripts.text: It was a small bath boiler at the time, and it was often overloaded with water from so many baths. It couldn't withstand the high pressure.
scripts.translation: 动人偶。那时浴场锅炉还很小，却常因浴池使用过度而超负荷，根本承受不住压力。

scripts.text: Anyways, it exploded while I was working on it, and the other automatic doll was burned down. Maybe it's that automatic doll.
scripts.translation: 总之，我维修时锅炉爆炸了，另一台自动人偶也被烧毁。也许就是那台人偶。不

scripts.text: I wonder if that doll's data was engraved in some unknown way. In this boiler.
scripts.translation: 知道它的数据是否以某种未知方式留在锅炉里了。

scripts.text: This boiler move sometimes on its own without anyone using it, but I think the data from the past automatic dolls remains and continues to carry out commands.
scripts.translation: 没人使用时，锅炉有时也会自己运转。我想是过去那台自动人偶的数据残留下来，继续执行指令。这

scripts.text: Then it makes sense to hear the sound without form and make noises. You can also see strange shapes because of the steam that comes out.
scripts.translation: 样一来，没有实体却能听见声音、发出噪音也就说得通了。蒸汽还会形成奇怪的形状。

scripts.text: It's scary. The valve here think it's just a boiler. Is it scary? Valve, look over here.
scripts.translation: 是挺吓人的。这里的阀门却觉得这只是普通锅炉。阀门，你觉得可怕吗？看这边。

scripts.text: The boiler's spectre, do you think it makes sense? It's probably because of a problem that we haven't found yet. But maybe because we are automatic dolls.
scripts.translation: 锅炉幽灵？你觉得这说得通吗？可能还有我们没发现的故障。也许是因为我们都是自动人偶......

scripts.text: We think that there must be something missing because we can't hear the sounds or feel the signs like the human guests.
scripts.translation: 我们不像人类客人那样听得到声音、察觉到迹象，所以觉得一定遗漏了什么。

scripts.text: But in the end, we didn't even notice the existence of the problem. Problems that we probably won't find because of the limitations of us being a doll.
scripts.translation: 说到底，我们甚至没意识到问题存在。受限于人偶的能力，有些问题我们可能永远发现不了

scripts.text: That's why I suggested to find the problem with the guests.
scripts.translation: 。所以我才建议让客人帮忙查找。

scripts.text: Honestly, we didn't know what was weird because there were no customers for a long time. Not until the human guests came in, so isn't it reasonable to note the difference between humans and automatic dolls?
scripts.translation: 说实话，长时间没有顾客时，我们根本不知道哪里不对。直到人类客人来了才发现问题。比较人类和自动人偶的差异，不是很合理吗？

scripts.text: I heard that humans have developed senses and emotions. And the thinking ability to put it all together.
scripts.translation: 我听说人类有发达的感官和情感，也能把这些整合起

scripts.text: We only collect information and find a conclusion, but humans are different. I've heard you gather all personal experiences, thoughts, and imagination to come up with a conclusion.
scripts.translation: 来思考。我们只能收集信息、推导结论；人类则会结合个人经历、想法和想象得出结论。

scripts.text: I hope we can solve the problem.
scripts.translation: 希望我们能把问题解决。

scripts.text: Since the boiler has been turned off. Please tell the <NAVI>[other guests]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to search freely.
scripts.translation: 锅炉已经关了。请告诉<NAVI>[其他客人]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，现在可以自由搜查了。

scripts.text: Sweep, go meet the <NAVI>[other guests]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. I have to keep my eyes on the boiler. If you find out anything, come here and let me know. Because I'm curious.
scripts.translation: 斯威普，去找<NAVI>[其他客人]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。我得看着锅炉。有什么发现就回来告诉我，我很好奇。

scripts.text: It would be better to look somewhere else than this place.
What are you curious about? Do you have any questions for us?
scripts.translation: 你对什么好奇？有什么想问我们的吗？

scripts.text: Medicinal herbs? Are you curious about the herbs that is used in the bath? Why? Is the bath water not to your liking?
scripts.translation: 药草？你对浴池里用的药草感兴趣吗？为什么？是不喜欢浴水吗？

scripts.text: Is that why you came here?
scripts.translation: 所以你是为这个来的吗？

scripts.text: Boiler? Are you curious about the boiler? Why? Are you planning to steal the boiler?
scripts.translation: 锅炉？你对锅炉感兴趣？为什么？你打算把它偷走吗？

scripts.text: Oh, am I wrong? The intruder was very interested in the boiler and the supply system. They stealed the other boiler without my knowledge.
scripts.translation: 哦，我猜错了吗？入侵者对锅炉和供水系统很感兴趣，还趁我不注意偷走了另一台锅炉。

scripts.text: But. {0} doesn't seem to be interested in it. I was just wondering if you wanted to take the boiler. If i'm wrong then nevermind.
scripts.translation: 不过，{0}似乎对此不感兴趣。我只是想知道你是不是也想偷锅炉。如果我猜错了，那就算了。

scripts.text: But what will the intruder do with it? Do you think they're planning on making an open-air bath?
scripts.translation: 不过，入侵者偷锅炉要做什么？想建露天浴场吗？嗯.

scripts.text: Hmm.. I don't really know what they could do with the boiler. Can you humans make anything out of it? Do you have an idea, {0}?
scripts.translation: ……我实在想不出锅炉能有什么用途。人类能用它做什么？{0}，你有主意吗？

scripts.text: Hmmm... I liking soaking myself, but I'm more obsessed with the boiler. They seemed to be interested in the purification facility.
scripts.translation: 嗯......我喜欢泡澡，不过我更迷锅炉。他们似乎也对净化设施很感兴趣。

scripts.text: I was excited to explain about boilers. But I didn't know that they would steal it. I~ really didn't know. Is humans famous for acting on a whim?
scripts.translation: 我还兴致勃勃地给他们讲锅炉知识，没想到他们居然会偷走锅炉。我......真的没想到。人类都这么随心所欲吗？

scripts.text: {0}, are you acting on whim too? I don't know much about humans yet. There's a lot to know. That's how I prepare. I won't let them steal it again.
scripts.translation: {0}，你也这么随性吗？我对人类还不太了解，有很多东西要学。所以我得做好准备，不会再让他们偷走东西了。

scripts.text: For example. My master says that it's cool when he soaked in the bath, but when I soaked myself. It's incredibly hot. Did I set the temperature wrong? I did, but it wasn't for him.
scripts.translation: 比如，主人说泡澡很凉爽，可我自己泡时却觉得烫得受不了。是温度设错了吗？确实是我调的，不过那是按主人的要求设定的。

scripts.text: But it's cool. What does that mean? Am I mistaken?
scripts.translation: 他说凉爽是什么意思？是我弄错了吗？

scripts.text: And then. If you soak these dry leaves in hot water, the contents of the leaves comes out. But it's just that.
scripts.translation: 还有，把干叶子泡在热水里，叶子的成分就会出来，仅此而已。

scripts.text: But somehow it's good for your health, that's why we fill every bath with herbal leaves. Do humans breath on their skins? Or do you drink water from your skins?
scripts.translation: 可听说这对健康有益，所以每个浴池都放了草药叶。人类会用皮肤呼吸吗？还是用皮肤喝水？

scripts.text: Humans are happy to immerse themselves in the bath. Why is that?
scripts.translation: 人类为什么喜欢把身体泡在浴池里呢？

scripts.text: Oh, there's another one! Why do you put ground seaweed in the bath and apply the water on your face?
scripts.translation: 哦，还有！为什么要把磨碎的海藻放进浴池，再把水敷在脸上？

scripts.text: I was so curious that I tried it myself, but I didn't know what it was good for. Maybe because I'm an automatic doll?
scripts.translation: 我很好奇，就自己试了试，可不知道有什么用。难道是因为我是自动人偶？

scripts.text: If I had five senses like humans, I could have understand humans better. Why didn't the master gave us that?
scripts.translation: 如果我也有和人类一样的五感，就能更理解人类了。主人为什么没给我们这些能力呢？

scripts.text: It's all done. You have to drink now.
scripts.translation: 都准备好了，现在该喝了。

scripts.text: I'm not going to drink. No one's drinking.
Is not ready yet? Can't you just drink a little? Squeeze it out and you'll get a lot of essence.
scripts.translation: 还没好吗？不能先喝一点吗？挤一挤就能挤出很多精华。

scripts.text: Valve. Humans are not tea bags. Remember, I've said this many times.
scripts.translation: 阀门，人类不是茶包。我已经说过很多次了。

scripts.text: All you have to do is boil the water well.
The temperature needs to be increased to make it better.
I told you not to touch the boiler.
Stop it and come over here.
It's okay because it's quiet for a while.
scripts.translation: 暂时安静下来了，应该没事。

scripts.text: It looks dangerous, but the disposal...
scripts.translation: 看起来很危险，不过......要把它报废吗？

scripts.text: Why waste it! It'll still be useful if we fix it. Who am I supposed to work with if you scrap Valve? I don't like strangers.
scripts.translation: 为什么要报废！修好后还能用。要是你把阀门拆掉，我和谁一起工作？我不喜欢陌生人。

scripts.text: Because I can't leave my hands off the boiler? The intruders broke the boiler and the valves, and there was no time to fix them.
scripts.translation: 因为我得一直看着锅炉啊！入侵者弄坏了锅炉和阀门，当时根本没时间修。

scripts.text: I'm alone and the boiler room has to be ran by two, but I'm the only one left. There's no time to fix it. I can send it somewhere else, I'm worried that they'll reformat the data.
scripts.translation: 锅炉房原本要两个人一起运作，现在只剩我一个，根本抽不出时间修。送去别处修的话，我又怕他们把数据重置

scripts.text: It's not so serious, I can fix it slowly. Valve is not that bad, it only touches the boiler sometimes. I don't know much about humans, but I know a lot about herbs and boilers.
scripts.translation: 。情况也没那么糟，我可以慢慢修。阀门还好，只是偶尔会碰到锅炉。我不太懂人类，但很懂药草和锅炉。

scripts.text: But I still have to fix it.
If you're free, please help me. I'm short on hands. The valve and the boiler needs to be fixed. But I'm alone and the other dolls are busy.
scripts.translation: 有空的话请帮帮我，人手不够。锅炉和阀门都要修，但我一个人忙不过来，其他人偶也

scripts.text: I wish I were two. Wow... wouldn't it be nice? If there were two of me, this would be the best boiler room.
scripts.translation: 都很忙。真希望我能有两个自己！那样这里就是最棒的锅炉房了。

scripts.text: I'll ask Alpha to clone me. I don't know if it's possible, but logically, it's more efficient if there's two of me.
scripts.translation: 我会请阿尔法克隆一个我。不知道能不能做到，但按理说两个我效率更高。

scripts.text: But, what can I do right now? There's no other me. I should ask for help. So please help me if you're free.
scripts.translation: 不过眼下没有另一个我，只能找人帮忙。所以有空的话请帮帮我。

scripts.text: I have to go take a bath.
Really? Then there's nothing I can do. You also look tired, so I'll send you herbs for recovery. Goodbye.
scripts.translation: 这样啊，那我也没办法。你看起来也累了，我给你些恢复用的药草吧。再见。

scripts.text: Thank you. Then, can you handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000? I also need 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。能帮忙处理20个故障自动人偶，带回5个故障自动人偶零件吗？ ^0000CD^000000^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: What brings you here today? Oh, is it for work?
scripts.translation: 今天来有什么事？哦，是来帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I don't know why you are here. Nothing has changed here. We are still working on the boiler.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我也不知道你为什么来。这里没什么变化，我们还在忙着修理锅炉。

scripts.text: Umm... I heard humans break down easily if they work too much. Please go get some rest and come back after dawn.
scripts.translation: 嗯......听说人类工作太久会累坏。先去休息吧，天亮后再回来。

scripts.text: I'l like to take a break today.
That's weird. I thought you came to see me because you want to get work, right? Well, I understand.
scripts.translation: 真奇怪，我还以为你是来找活干的。嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text: How can there be such a sincere human? Then, today too please handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000 and bring 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.
scripts.translation: 竟然有这么热心的人类！那今天也拜托你处理20个故障自动人偶，并带回5个故障自动人偶零件。 ^0000CD^000000^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Are you done with your work?
Where is it? We need 5 Broken Automatic Doll Parts. I think there is a hole in your bag. You should check it.
